long_biography.plain_text:
Norwegian investor Thor Johan Furuholmen worked with Marius Flaaten to make skiing a more frequent activity through a different pricing model. After Vidsjå bought out its ski-resort partner, they developed a membership strategy intended to encourage repeat visits. Skimore offered access across its resorts through an annual subscription, payable upfront or in monthly instalments.

The company supported this model with an application covering membership, payments and access. Its systems tracked visits and how often members returned, helping the business assess customer activity. Subscription income also provided a more predictable revenue base for resorts that combined winter skiing with summer climbing and cycling.
